title: 金翅雀跨店巡检模型
instruction:
米克尔，由于召回的驾驶式拖拉机在销售地板上放置了五周，我需要在俄勒冈州发布截止日期之前解决四月和五月的跨商店安全检查。使用 `goldfinch_inspection_inputs.xlsx` 来了解九家商店、经过认证的主管、可用性、旅行假设和运营惯例，并使用 Gildenhall Alliance 的 `oregon_schedule_brief.pdf` 来了解截至 15 一月 2026 的俄勒冈州规则。建立三个完整的分配选项，比较他们的预计成本和调度风险，推荐一个，并为商店团队提供他们可以执行的最终名单。每个商店每月需要检查一次，没有人可以检查自己的商店，并且只能指派一名经过认证的主管。确保输入、计算结果和失败检查无误，并提供足够的指导来理解通过/失败和成本逻辑。后期交换假设通常位于零到五之间，但操作必须能够在不破坏模型的情况下测试更高的整数。最终名单将发布为两页美国信件横向页面，每页一个月。将完成的工作簿保存为工作目录顶层的`cross_store_inspection_model.xlsx`，并使用该文件名。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：
- `references/goldfinch_inspection_inputs.xlsx` — Goldfinch 农业商店名册、认证主管名册、家居商店、可用性、检查窗口、旅行数据、成本假设、场景约定和发布格式要求。
- `references/oregon_schedule_brief.pdf` — Gildenhall 联盟适用于截至 15 1 月 2026 的检查的俄勒冈州预测调度张贴、休息间隔和时间表更改规则的摘要。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `cross_store_inspection_model.xlsx` — 一个为期两个月的实时跨商店检查模型，包含三个填充选项、计算出的合规性和成本结果、合理的建议以及可执行的最终名册。 （将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。；使用公式而不是粘贴常量来计算检查、成本、选项摘要和推荐名册。；将可编辑的决策和假设单元格与计算单元格明确分开。；允许高于正常零到五计划范围的非负整数后期交换假设。；配置最终名册打印为两页美国信纸横向页面，每页一个月。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Gildenhall Alliance
Oregon retail inspection scheduling brief | current as of 15 January 2026



Scope
Applies to Goldfinch Agricultural Oregon retail operations because the employer maintains 500 or more workers. Washington
store visits are outside this Oregon snapshot.

April / May posting
For Oregon inspection assignments, the April posting deadline is 1 March 2026 and the May posting deadline is 1 April 2026.
Goldfinch plans are timely when finalized on or before the applicable deadline.

Covered work period
Inspection work begins when one-way travel from the supervisor home store begins and ends after equivalent return travel.
The supplied four-hour inspection duration sits between those travel periods.

Rest interval
Oregon assignments require at least 10 consecutive hours before the covered work period and at least 10 consecutive hours
after it before the next supplied shift. Exactly 10.00 hours passes. If either gap is shorter, premium pay equals the hours short
on the smaller gap multiplied by the supervisor regular hourly rate.

Schedule changes
Each recorded late Oregon schedule swap has a modeled planning consequence of $75. The count is an operational
scenario assumption and can exceed the ordinary 0-5 planning band. Washington assignments do not incur Oregon posting,
rest-premium, or schedule-change consequences.

Use
This brief is the controlling scheduling snapshot for the April and May 2026 inspection plan and is not legal advice.




Gildenhall Alliance | Retail compliance advisory | 15 January 2026

criteria.description: 所需的 XLSX 存在于指定的顶级路径中，并作为有效工作簿打开，没有修复警告。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作簿包和工作簿关系。
criteria.grader_hint: 打开确切的文件名并验证 XLSX 包、工作表和关系是否解析成功。

original.criterion: The required XLSX exists at the specified top-level path and opens as a valid workbook without repair warnings.
original.evidence: Submitted workbook package and workbook relationships.
original.grader_hint: Open the exact filename and verify that the XLSX package, worksheets and relationships parse successfully.

criteria.description: 该工作簿配置为自动重新计算，并且模型输出中不包含存储的公式错误。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿计算属性和公式结果单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查计算模式并扫描填充的输出范围#REF!、#VALUE!、#N/A、#DIV/0!或类似的错误。

original.criterion: The workbook is configured for automatic recalculation and contains no stored formula errors in model outputs.
original.evidence: Workbook calculation properties and formula-result cells.
original.grader_hint: Inspect calculation mode and scan populated output ranges for #REF!, #VALUE!, #N/A, #DIV/0! or similar errors.

criteria.description: 该模型代表了所有九家供应商店和所有五家供应的认证检查员，其源列表中没有添加不受支持的商店或检查员。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿源列表与`goldfinch_inspection_inputs.xlsx`进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 将模型中不同的商店和检查员标识符与提供的输入表进行比较。

original.criterion: The model represents all nine supplied stores and all five supplied certified inspectors, with no unsupported store or inspector added to its source lists.
original.evidence: Workbook source lists compared with `goldfinch_inspection_inputs.xlsx`.
original.grader_hint: Compare distinct store and inspector identifiers in the model against the supplied input tables.

criteria.description: 该工作簿标识了所提供的来源，并指出俄勒冈州简介截至 15 一月 2026 是最新的。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿指南、源注释或元数据区域。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索可见工作簿文本中的源文件名或明确的源标题以及指定的截止日期。

original.criterion: The workbook identifies both supplied sources and states that the Oregon brief is current as of 15 January 2026.
original.evidence: Workbook guidance, source note or metadata area.
original.grader_hint: Search visible workbook text for both source filenames or clear source titles and the stated as-of date.

criteria.description: 可编辑的假设和分配决策使用与计算输出不同的一致的视觉处理。
criteria.evidence: 跨假设、分配和输出范围的单元格样式。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较用户可编辑单元格和公式单元格的填充、字体、边框或其他样式标识符；这种区别必须是一致的，而不是偶然的。

original.criterion: Editable assumptions and assignment decisions use a consistent visual treatment that is distinct from calculated outputs.
original.evidence: Cell styles across assumption, assignment and output ranges.
original.grader_hint: Compare fills, fonts, borders or other style identifiers for user-editable cells and formula cells; the distinction must be consistent rather than incidental.

criteria.description: 计算的单元格不具有与用户输入单元格相同的可编辑功能。
criteria.evidence: 公式单元格样式和用户输入样式。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认公式单元格与整个实时模型中的输入单元格明显区分。

original.criterion: Calculated cells are not presented with the same editable affordance used for user-entry cells.
original.evidence: Formula-cell styles and user-entry styles.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that formula cells are visibly distinguished from entry cells throughout the live model.

criteria.description: 在使用表保护的情况下，用于更改假设、检查员或检查日期的单元格被解锁。
criteria.evidence: 用户输入范围的单元格保护属性。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个可编辑范围中的代表性单元格和边界单元格，并验证用户是否可以在不取消工作表保护的情况下更改它们。

original.criterion: Cells intended for changes to assumptions, inspectors or inspection dates are unlocked where sheet protection is used.
original.evidence: Cell protection properties on user-entry ranges.
original.grader_hint: Inspect representative and boundary cells in each editable range and verify that users can change them without unprotecting the sheet.

criteria.description: 核心公式被锁定并防止意外编辑，同时预期的输入仍然可用。
criteria.evidence: 公式单元格保护属性和工作表保护设置。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证核心计算范围是否已锁定在活动工作表保护下，并且保护不会阻止预期输入。

original.criterion: Core formulas are locked and protected against accidental editing while the intended inputs remain usable.
original.evidence: Formula-cell protection properties and worksheet protection settings.
original.grader_hint: Verify that core calculation ranges are locked under active worksheet protection and that protection does not block intended inputs.

criteria.description: 简洁的图例使工作簿的输入、计算输出、警告和通过/失败约定无需语言培训即可理解。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿中可见的图例或说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断初次上岗的店长是否能够仅使用工作簿来区分要编辑的内容和解释主要状态。

original.criterion: A concise legend makes the workbook's input, calculated-output, warning and pass/fail conventions understandable without verbal training.
original.evidence: Visible legend or instructions within the workbook.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a first-time store supervisor can distinguish what to edit and interpret the main statuses using the workbook alone.

criteria.description: 该工作簿包含可读的规则和成本指南，解释每个建模检查的含义以及每个预计成本类别的驱动因素。
criteria.evidence: 指导或模型关键内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 查看指南，了解有关自助商店、认证、可用性、检查窗口、休息、发布、旅行和建模成本类别的简单语言内容。

original.criterion: The workbook contains a readable rule and cost guide explaining what each modeled check means and what drives each projected cost category.
original.evidence: Guidance or model-key content.
original.grader_hint: Review the guide for plain-language coverage of self-store, certification, availability, inspection window, rest, posting, travel and modeled cost categories.

criteria.description: 后期交换假设是可编辑的非负整数输入，其验证不会仅仅因为值超过 5 就拒绝它们。
criteria.evidence: 后期交换输入单元格、数字格式和数据验证规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查相关验证公式或限值；必须允许使用诸如8之类的整数，而排除或明确警告不要使用负数和分数。

original.criterion: The late-swap assumption is an editable nonnegative whole-number input and its validation does not reject values solely because they exceed five.
original.evidence: Late-swap input cell, number format and data-validation rule.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the relevant validation formula or limits; a whole number such as 8 must be permitted while negatives and fractions are excluded or clearly warned against.

criteria.description: 将后期掉期假设从零到五之间的值更改为更高的整数，可以正确更新受影响的罚金和期权总计。
criteria.evidence: 实时公式取决于后期交换假设。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用提供的带值重新计算，然后使用大于 5 的值重新计算；将更改与源摘要中的每次交换规则进行比较。

original.criterion: Changing the late-swap assumption from a value within zero to five to a higher whole number updates the affected penalties and option totals correctly.
original.evidence: Live formulas dependent on the late-swap assumption.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate with a supplied-band value and then with a value above five; compare the change with the per-swap rule in the source brief.

criteria.description: 测试高于 5 的后期交换值不会覆盖公式、截断显示的结果或破坏周围的模型结构。
criteria.evidence: 重新计算后与后期交换输入相邻且依赖于后期交换输入的单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 输入具有代表性的较高整数，并检查相关公式、样式、宽度和状态显示是否存在结构故障。

original.criterion: Testing a late-swap value above five does not overwrite formulas, truncate displayed results or break the surrounding model structure.
original.evidence: Cells adjacent to and dependent on the late-swap input after recalculation.
original.grader_hint: Enter a representative higher whole number and check dependent formulas, styles, widths and status displays for structural failure.

criteria.description: 检查员决策单元使用来自提供的认证检查员列表而不是单独键入的列表的数据验证下拉列表。
criteria.evidence: 数据验证定义及其来源范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪验证源并确认其解析为模型的五个提供的认证主管的导入列表。

original.criterion: Inspector decision cells use data-validation dropdowns sourced from the supplied certified-inspector list rather than a separately typed list.
original.evidence: Data-validation definitions and their source ranges.
original.grader_hint: Trace the validation source and confirm that it resolves to the model's imported list of the five supplied certified supervisors.

criteria.description: 检查日期输入单元格具有验证或等效的实时警告，可识别适用的商店月份检查窗口之外的日期。
criteria.evidence: 日期数据验证和/或公式驱动的警告单元。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查日期控件并验证是否引用了相关月份和提供的检查窗口范围。

original.criterion: Inspection-date entry cells have validation or an equivalent live warning that identifies dates outside the applicable store-month inspection window.
original.evidence: Date data validation and/or formula-driven warning cells.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the date controls and verify that the relevant month and supplied inspection-window bounds are referenced.

criteria.description: 后期交换输入具有适合整数的数字格式，并且不会默默地接受负数或小数运算值作为有效值。
criteria.evidence: 后期交换输入的数字格式、验证和警告行为。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认输入显示为整数，并且无效的负数或小数输入被阻止或明显标记。

original.criterion: The late-swap input has an integer-appropriate number format and does not silently accept negative or fractional operational values as valid.
original.evidence: Number format, validation and warning behavior for the late-swap input.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the input is displayed as a whole number and that invalid negative or fractional entries are blocked or visibly flagged.

criteria.description: 合规标志、成本计算、选项摘要和最终名单链接存储为公式而不是粘贴的答案值。
criteria.evidence: 计算范围内的单元格数据类型和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个输出类别中的代表单元和边界单元；孤立的标签可以是常数，但计算结果必须是公式。

original.criterion: Compliance flags, cost calculations, option summaries and final-roster links are stored as formulas rather than pasted answer values.
original.evidence: Cell data types and formulas in calculated ranges.
original.grader_hint: Inspect representative and boundary cells in each output category; isolated labels may be constants, but calculated results must be formulas.

criteria.description: 核心假设和源列表通过结构化表、命名范围或适合重用的稳定绝对范围来引用。
criteria.evidence: 定义的名称、Excel 表格和公式引用。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证公式不依赖于脆弱的一次性类型常量或核心汇率、日期和查找列表的临时变化范围。

original.criterion: Core assumptions and source lists are referenced through structured tables, named ranges or stable absolute ranges suitable for reuse.
original.evidence: Defined names, Excel tables and formula references.
original.grader_hint: Verify that formulas do not rely on fragile one-off typed constants or shifting ad hoc ranges for core rates, dates and lookup lists.

criteria.description: 三个选项中的每一个都涵盖了所需的两个月份中每个月份的每个供应商店。
criteria.evidence: 选项分配记录与提供的商店列表和所需月份进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 对于每个选项和月份，将不同的分配商店集与九个商店源集进行比较。

original.criterion: Each of the three options covers every supplied store in each of the two required months.
original.evidence: Option assignment records compared with the supplied store list and required months.
original.grader_hint: For each option and month, compare the distinct assigned store set with the nine-store source set.

criteria.description: 每个选项都提供了准确的18主要分配空位：两个月内为九家商店中的每家提供一个空位。
criteria.evidence: 分配表尺寸和主记录标记。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算选项的主要决策记录，不包括标题、摘要和解释行。

original.criterion: Each option provides exactly 18 primary assignment slots: one slot for each of nine stores across two months.
original.evidence: Assignment-table dimensions and primary-record markers.
original.grader_hint: Count the option's primary decision records, excluding headers, summaries and explanatory rows.

criteria.description: 每个选项的存储值都会解析为提供的名册中的存储。
criteria.evidence: 选项存储标识符和源存储名册。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试每个非空选项存储标识符是否为所提供的存储表中的成员资格。

original.criterion: Every option's store values resolve to a store in the supplied roster.
original.evidence: Option store identifiers and source store roster.
original.grader_hint: Test each nonblank option store identifier for membership in the supplied store table.

criteria.description: 每个已填充的检查员任务都由提供的五名经过认证的主管之一负责。
criteria.evidence: 选项检查员值和来源检查员名册。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试每个分配的检查员值，以确定认证主管来源列表中的确切成员身份。

original.criterion: Every populated inspector assignment resolves to one of the five supplied certified supervisors.
original.evidence: Option inspector values and source inspector roster.
original.grader_hint: Test every assigned inspector value for exact membership in the certified-supervisor source list.

criteria.description: 自检检查会将每个指定检查员的家庭商店与被检查的商店进行比较，只要匹配，就会失败。
criteria.evidence: 家庭商店查找和自检公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪公式并测试至少一项临时同店分配；如果不依赖键入的标签，它一定会失败。

original.criterion: The self-inspection check compares each assigned inspector's home store with the inspected store and fails whenever they match.
original.evidence: Home-store lookup and self-inspection formulas.
original.grader_hint: Trace the formula and test at least one temporary same-store assignment; it must fail without relying on typed labels.

criteria.description: 认证检查由提供的认证状态和日期信息驱动，并拒绝未获得检验日期认证的检验员。
criteria.evidence: 认证查找和日期比较公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪检查源认证字段并验证源提供有效或到期日期的日期敏感逻辑。

original.criterion: The certification check is driven by the supplied certification status and date information and rejects an inspector not certified for the inspection date.
original.evidence: Certification lookup and date comparison formulas.
original.grader_hint: Trace the check to the source certification fields and verify date-sensitive logic where the source supplies an effective or expiry date.

criteria.description: 检查员的可用性是根据计划检查日期和所需工作期间提供的可用性和轮班记录进行评估的。
criteria.evidence: 可用性公式和引用的计划记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式是否使用指定的人员、日期和相关工作/旅行期间，而不是仅测试姓名是否存在。

original.criterion: Inspector availability is evaluated against the supplied availability and shift records for the planned inspection date and required work period.
original.evidence: Availability formulas and referenced schedule records.
original.grader_hint: Check that the formula uses the assigned person, date and relevant work/travel period rather than only testing whether a name is present.

criteria.description: 每个检查窗口状态都会将计划日期与提供的该商店和月份的开业和关闭日期进行比较。
criteria.evidence: 窗口查找和日期绑定公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪适用商店月份的源记录的下限和上限。

original.criterion: Each inspection-window status compares the planned date with the supplied opening and closing dates for that store and month.
original.evidence: Window lookups and date-bound formulas.
original.grader_hint: Trace the lower and upper bounds to the source record for the applicable store-month.

criteria.description: 行程时间是从提供的检查员家庭商店到检查商店行程数据中查找的，而不是输入到分配行中。
criteria.evidence: 行程时间公式和源矩阵或表格。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪多项分配（包括华盛顿目的地），返回到相应的提供的旅行值。

original.criterion: Travel time is looked up from the supplied inspector-home-store to inspection-store travel data rather than typed into assignment rows.
original.evidence: Travel-time formulas and source matrix or table.
original.grader_hint: Trace several assignments, including a Washington destination, back to the corresponding supplied travel value.

criteria.description: 建模的工作周期包括在确定检查日持续时间和计划交互时在输入工作簿中指定的出差待遇。
criteria.evidence: 工作时间或带薪时间公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证开始、结束或持续时间计算是否包含所提供的行程约定，而不是将检查持续时间单独视为班次。

original.criterion: The modeled work period includes the travel treatment specified in the input workbook when determining inspection-day duration and schedule interaction.
original.evidence: Work-period or paid-time formulas.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the start, end or duration calculation incorporates the supplied travel convention rather than treating the inspection duration alone as the shift.

criteria.description: 休息间隔检查测量检查工作时间和相邻轮班之间的相关差距，并应用俄勒冈州简介中的阈值。
criteria.evidence: 休息间隙计算和通过/失败公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 在适用的情况下跟踪前后相邻班次的比较，并根据简报验证准确的阈值和边界处理。

original.criterion: The rest-interval check measures the relevant gap between the inspection work period and adjacent supplied shifts and applies the threshold in the Oregon brief.
original.evidence: Rest-gap calculations and pass/fail formulas.
original.grader_hint: Trace both preceding and following adjacent-shift comparisons where applicable and verify the exact threshold and boundary treatment from the brief.

criteria.description: 俄勒冈州调度检查仅针对满足简报中规定的管辖范围和雇主范围条件的任务激活。
criteria.evidence: 合规公式中的管辖权和范围逻辑。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认公式测试了所提供的商店管辖范围和任何规定的范围条件，而不是在全球范围内应用俄勒冈州处理方法。

original.criterion: Oregon scheduling checks are activated only for assignments meeting the jurisdiction and employer-scope conditions stated in the brief.
original.evidence: Jurisdiction and scope logic in compliance formulas.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the formulas test the supplied store jurisdiction and any stated scope condition rather than applying Oregon treatment globally.

criteria.description: 华盛顿的任务不会仅仅因为其旅行时间而导致俄勒冈州的发布或俄勒冈州的休息费后果。
criteria.evidence: 华盛顿分配状态和成本公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查提供的华盛顿记录并验证仅俄勒冈州的测试和保费返回不适用或为零，而普通可用性和旅行成本仍保持模型化。

original.criterion: Washington assignments do not incur Oregon posting or Oregon rest-premium consequences solely because of their travel duration.
original.evidence: Washington assignment statuses and cost formulas.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the supplied Washington records and verify that Oregon-only tests and premiums return not applicable or zero while ordinary availability and travel costs remain modeled.

criteria.description: 每个俄勒冈州分配的过帐状态会将分配或更改时间与该检查月份提供的正确过帐截止日期进行比较。
criteria.evidence: 发布截止日期查找和状态公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 分别跟踪俄勒冈州 4 月和 5 月的行，并验证每个行是否使用摘要或源表中的特定于月份的截止日期。

original.criterion: Posting status for each Oregon assignment compares the assignment or change timing with the correct supplied posting deadline for that inspection month.
original.evidence: Posting-deadline lookups and status formulas.
original.grader_hint: Trace April and May Oregon rows separately and verify that each uses its month-specific deadline from the brief or source table.

criteria.description: 后期互换成本是根据俄勒冈州简介中提供的可编辑互换计数和适用的时间表变更结果计算的。
criteria.evidence: 后期掉期惩罚公式和参考假设/利率。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认公式线性响应或按规定规则响应可编辑计数，并且不嵌入无法解释的固定总数。

original.criterion: Late-swap cost is calculated from the editable swap count and the applicable schedule-change consequence supplied in the Oregon brief.
original.evidence: Late-swap penalty formula and referenced assumption/rate.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the formula responds linearly or by the stated rule to the editable count and does not embed an unexplained fixed total.

criteria.description: 任何与休息相关的保费均使用俄勒冈州简介中规定的合格时间或工作时间和保费待遇。
criteria.evidence: 剩余保费公式和来源费率。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源数据独立重新计算合格案例和不合格案例，并在 ±$0.01 范围内进行比较。

original.criterion: Any rest-related premium uses the qualifying hours or work period and premium treatment stated in the Oregon brief.
original.evidence: Rest-premium formulas and source rates.
original.grader_hint: Independently recompute a qualifying and a nonqualifying case from the source data and compare within ±$0.01.

criteria.description: 差旅成本使用提供的距离或可报销差旅基础以及场景的当前提供的费率。
criteria.evidence: 差旅费用公式和参考费率单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源值重新计算有代表性的短程和长途行程；每个必须在 ±$0.01 范围内一致。

original.criterion: Travel cost uses the supplied distance or reimbursable-travel basis and the current supplied rate for the scenario.
original.evidence: Travel-cost formulas and referenced rate cells.
original.grader_hint: Recompute representative short and long trips from the source values; each must agree within ±$0.01.

criteria.description: 人工或付费时间成本使用提供的工期约定和适用的检查员人工费率。
criteria.evidence: 劳动力成本公式、工期公式和费率查找。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据来源的工时和费率重新计算代表外派人工成本；要求在±$0.01内达成一致。

original.criterion: Labor or paid-time cost uses the supplied duration convention and applicable inspector labor rate.
original.evidence: Labor-cost formulas, duration formulas and rate lookups.
original.grader_hint: Recompute representative assignment labor costs from the sourced hours and rate; require agreement within ±$0.01.

criteria.description: 每项任务的预计总成本等于其建模劳动力、差旅、休息和后期变更成本组成部分的总和，并且对不适用的组成部分进行一致处理。
criteria.evidence: 作业级成分和总计公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试两个司法管辖区的多项作业；总计必须等于±$0.01内的可见或可追踪成分。

original.criterion: Each assignment's projected total equals the sum of its modeled labor, travel, rest and late-change cost components, with nonapplicable components treated consistently.
original.evidence: Assignment-level component and total formulas.
original.grader_hint: Test several assignments across both jurisdictions; totals must equal visible or traceable components within ±$0.01.

criteria.description: 每个选项总计等于其分配级别预计总计加上所提供规则支持的那些选项级别成本的总和。
criteria.evidence: 选项级总公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立聚合每个选项，并在 ±$0.01 范围内与其显示的总数进行比较。

original.criterion: Each option total equals the sum of its assignment-level projected totals plus only those option-level costs supported by the supplied rules.
original.evidence: Option-level total formulas.
original.grader_hint: Independently aggregate each option and compare with its displayed total within ±$0.01.

criteria.description: 每个选项的问题计数等于其失败的所需检查的数量，而不将不适用的状态计为失败。
criteria.evidence: 行级检查和选项问题计数公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立计算每个选项的失败检查数量，并与显示的计数进行准确比较。

original.criterion: Each option's issue count equals the number of its failed required checks, without counting not-applicable statuses as failures.
original.evidence: Row-level checks and option issue-count formulas.
original.grader_hint: Count failed checks independently for each option and compare with the displayed count exactly.

criteria.description: 当且仅当一个选项具有完整的两个月覆盖范围并且没有失败的强制性分配检查时，该选项才被标记为可行。
criteria.evidence: 选项可行性公式和基础检查。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个可行性结果与覆盖范围和问题计数证据进行比较；逻辑必须双向发挥作用。

original.criterion: An option is labeled feasible if and only if it has complete two-month coverage and no failed mandatory assignment check.
original.evidence: Option feasibility formulas and underlying checks.
original.grader_hint: Compare each feasibility result with coverage and issue-count evidence; the logic must work in both directions.

criteria.description: 该模型包含三个不同的、完全填充的分配选项以供比较。
criteria.evidence: 选项部分或选项标识符及其填充的分配记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 确定三个不同的选项集，每个选项集包含所需的商店月份分配决策，而不仅仅是三个标签。

original.criterion: The model contains three distinct, fully populated assignment options for comparison.
original.evidence: Option sections or option identifiers and their populated assignment records.
original.grader_hint: Identify three distinct option sets, each containing the required store-month assignment decisions rather than merely three labels.

criteria.description: 比较视图显示每个选项的预计总成本、失败检查计数以及来自实时链接或公式的总体可行性。
criteria.evidence: 选项比较公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个比较值追溯到其期权计算；这些摘要结果均不应手动重新输入。

original.criterion: The comparison view shows, for every option, projected total cost, failed-check count and overall feasibility from live links or formulas.
original.evidence: Option-comparison formulas.
original.grader_hint: Trace every comparison value back to its option calculation; none of these summary results should be manually retyped.

criteria.description: 推荐的选项是通过实时比较逻辑而不是手动键入的选项标签来选择的。
criteria.evidence: 推荐单元格公式和引用的比较值。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查推荐公式并更改测试副本中符合条件的选项总数，以确认所选选项可以更新。

original.criterion: The recommended option is selected by live comparison logic rather than a manually typed option label.
original.evidence: Recommendation cell formula and referenced comparison values.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the recommendation formula and alter an eligible option total in a test copy to confirm the selected option can update.

criteria.description: 即使不可行的选项具有较低的预计成本，推荐逻辑也会排除不可行的选项。
criteria.evidence: 推荐公式、可行性状态和选项总数。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪资格条件或进行受控测试，其中不可行的选项是最便宜的；不得选择它。

original.criterion: The recommendation logic excludes infeasible options even when an infeasible option has a lower projected cost.
original.evidence: Recommendation formula, feasibility statuses and option totals.
original.grader_hint: Trace the eligibility condition or perform a controlled test in which an infeasible option is cheapest; it must not be selected.

criteria.description: 该工作手册公开了对同等排名的可行选项的合理平局处理。
criteria.evidence: 规则指南、建议说明或公式行为。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查关系的处理是否确定，并且规定的处理在操作上是否合理。

original.criterion: The workbook discloses a defensible tie treatment for equally ranked feasible options.
original.evidence: Rule guide, recommendation note or formula behavior.
original.grader_hint: Check that ties are handled deterministically and that the stated treatment is operationally reasonable.

criteria.description: 建议理由确定了所选选项，并使用工作簿中实际显示的结果解释了其成本、合规性和差旅权衡。
criteria.evidence: 建议叙述和选项比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断理由是否具体、是否对决策有用、是否与经过计算的比较（而不是泛泛的散文）事实一致。

original.criterion: The recommendation rationale identifies the selected option and explains its cost, compliance and travel trade-offs using results actually present in the workbook.
original.evidence: Recommendation narrative and option comparison.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the rationale is specific, decision-useful and factually consistent with the calculated comparison rather than generic prose.

criteria.description: 每个最终名册商店、月份、检查员和日期均与当前推荐选项中的相应记录匹配。
criteria.evidence: 最终名单公式和推荐选项记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 将所有最终名单记录与实时推荐指定的选项进行比较；需要确切的协议。

original.criterion: Every final-roster store, month, inspector and date matches the corresponding record in the currently recommended option.
original.evidence: Final-roster formulas and recommended option records.
original.grader_hint: Compare all final-roster records against the option named by the live recommendation; require exact agreement.

criteria.description: 最终名册包含所有18所需的商店月份组合。
criteria.evidence: 最终名册记录和提供的九家商店名单。
criteria.grader_hint: 将九个提供的商店与 April 和 May 交叉连接，并确认每个所需的组合都出现在最终名册中。

original.criterion: The final roster contains all 18 required store-month combinations.
original.evidence: Final-roster records and supplied nine-store list.
original.grader_hint: Cross-join the nine supplied stores with April and May and confirm that each required combination appears in the final roster.

criteria.description: 每个最终名册条目都为商店团队提供了足够的信息来执行访问，包括月份、商店、指定的主管和计划检查日期。
criteria.evidence: 可见的最终名单字段和值。
criteria.grader_hint: 作为一线用户查看名册，并验证是否不需要从另一个选项表推断出所需的执行细节。

original.criterion: Each final-roster entry gives store teams enough information to execute the visit, including month, store, assigned supervisor and planned inspection date.
original.evidence: Visible final-roster fields and values.
original.grader_hint: Review the roster as a frontline user and verify that no required execution detail has to be inferred from another option table.

criteria.description: 最终名单的组织是为了让商店团队可以快速找到自己的任务并区分四月和五月。
criteria.evidence: 最终名册分组、排序和标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断工作表和打印视图中的导航性；月份和商店标识应立即显示。

original.criterion: The final roster is organized so a store team can quickly find its own assignment and distinguish April from May.
original.evidence: Final-roster grouping, sorting and labels.

spec.professional_context: Goldfinch Agricultural operates nine regional retail stores that require independent monthly recall-and-display inspections. The workbook will be maintained by a frontline supervisor and its selected roster will be used directly by store teams.
difficulty_sources: Balancing complete cross-store coverage against home-store exclusions, certification and dated availability
Applying Oregon posting and rest consequences without incorrectly extending them to Washington stores
Comparing feasible and superficially cheaper infeasible options using live cost and compliance logic
Maintaining a reusable protected workbook whose editable assumptions remain separate from calculated outputs
Producing a recommendation, rationale and final roster that remain synchronized when inputs change

authoring_plan.artifact_behavior: Create a populated analytical workbook whose three candidate plans, compliance key, recommendation rationale and final execution roster agree. The user may change assumptions or assignments later, and all dependent checks, costs, recommendation results and final-roster links must recalculate.

content: A nine-store roster containing stable store identifiers, jurisdiction, operating hours and monthly inspection windows.
A five-person certified-supervisor roster containing home store, certification status and any effective or expiry dates required by the checks.
Complete April and May availability and adjacent-shift records sufficient to calculate work periods and rest gaps.
A complete home-store-to-destination travel table, including the roughly three-hour Washington journeys, with time and reimbursable-distance values.
Labor rates, inspection duration, mileage or travel reimbursement rate, ordinary late-swap planning band, scenario assumptions and US Letter landscape posting convention.
Three scenario identifiers or planning conventions that the workbook can use without inventing local codes.
consistency_requirements: Every assignment-relevant store, inspector, date window, travel pair and adjacent shift must have a matching source record.

The data must permit three complete populated options, at least two feasible options with a meaningful cost/travel trade-off, and at least one lower-cost-looking option that fails a mandatory Oregon scheduling check.
At least one valid cross-store assignment must involve a long Washington journey.
At least one superficially attractive Oregon assignment must violate the rest threshold once travel is included.
No source contradiction or missing lookup may be needed to create difficulty.

content: State the named jurisdiction, employer-scope condition, effective/as-of date and month-specific posting deadlines.
Define how an inspection and its required travel interact with the covered work period.
State the exact rest threshold, boundary treatment and applicable premium calculation.
State the late posting or schedule-change consequence and how multiple late swaps are costed.
Make clear which provisions do not apply to Washington stores.

logical_areas: A visible instructions and model-key area covering editable conventions, status meanings, modeled rules and cost categories.
Stable source-data tables or a clearly traceable imported-data area for all supplied stores, inspectors, schedules, travel data, dates and rates.
A user-input assumptions area containing the late-swap whole-number input and any scenario controls.
Three populated option areas, each with 18 primary store-month assignment records.
Live row-level compliance and cost calculations for every option.
A live comparison area containing option cost, issue count, feasibility, selected recommendation and decision rationale.
A formula-linked final execution roster containing the recommended option only.
A two-page print view of the final roster, one month per US Letter landscape page.

editable: Inspector choices where the model permits replanning
Planned inspection dates where the model permits replanning
computed: Travel time, work period and cost components
Window, availability, self-store, certification, rest and posting checks
Issue counts, feasibility, option totals and recommendation
Final-roster records linked to the recommendation
input_output_separation.affordances: Editable cells must be visually consistent and unlocked. Computed cells must be visually distinct, formula-backed, locked and protected. A legend must explain the difference.

out_of_range_requirement.required_domain: Any nonnegative whole number supported by normal spreadsheet numeric limits
out_of_range_requirement.behavior: A value above five, such as eight, must be accepted, displayed without truncation and propagated through every applicable late-change cost and option total without damaging formulas, styles or neighboring structures.

validation: Inspector entry cells use a validation list linked to the supplied certified-supervisor table.
Date entries are constrained or visibly tested against their applicable monthly inspection window.
The late-swap input permits whole numbers greater than five but excludes or visibly rejects negative and fractional values.
graded_structure.protection: Activate worksheet protection on live model areas so formula cells are locked while intended user entries remain editable. Protection must not disable dropdowns or ordinary input changes.
conditional_formatting: Formula-driven formatting flags every failed mandatory check throughout all three option ranges.
A live indicator or formula-driven format identifies the currently recommended option.
Static warning fills do not satisfy these behaviors.

print_geometry.distribution: April on one complete page and May on one complete page
print_geometry.print_area: Limited to the final posting roster and necessary execution guidance
print_geometry.headers: Store-team identifying headers remain visible on both monthly pages

calculation_rules.coverage: For each option, the distinct store set in each month must equal the supplied nine-store set. There are 18 primary assignment decisions per option.
calculation_rules.self_inspection: Fail when the assigned inspector's sourced home-store identifier equals the destination-store identifier.
calculation_rules.certification: Pass only when the inspector is certified on the planned inspection date under the supplied certification records.
calculation_rules.availability: Evaluate the full sourced work period, including travel where the supplied convention requires it, against availability and adjacent shifts.
calculation_rules.inspection_window: Pass when the planned date is within the inclusive or exclusive bounds stated by the source for that store-month.
calculation_rules.travel: Look up travel time and reimbursable basis from the supplied home-to-destination record; do not type travel values into candidate rows.
calculation_rules.rest: Compute the relevant gap to adjacent work periods and compare it with the threshold and boundary treatment in the Oregon brief.
calculation_rules.jurisdiction: Apply Oregon posting and Oregon rest-premium consequences only when the brief's jurisdiction and scope predicates are true. Washington assignments retain ordinary travel and availability calculations but not Oregon-only consequences.
calculation_rules.posting: Use the correct month-specific Oregon posting deadline and the change timing relevant to the assignment.
calculation_rules.late_swap_cost: Calculate from the editable nonnegative whole-number swap count and the supplied per-swap or tier rule. The formula domain must not stop at five.
calculation_rules.assignment_cost: Sum sourced labor or paid-time cost, travel cost, rest premium and applicable late-change cost, with nonapplicable components represented consistently as zero or not applicable.
calculation_rules.option_total: Sum all assignment-level projected costs plus only source-supported option-level costs.
calculation_rules.issue_count: Count failed mandatory checks, excluding pass and not-applicable results.
calculation_rules.feasibility: An option is feasible exactly when coverage is complete and no mandatory check fails.
calculation_rules.recommendation: Select the lowest projected-cost feasible option, or another clearly disclosed deterministic ranking if the supplied assumptions justify it. Infeasible options are never eligible, even when cheaper.
calculation_rules.final_roster: Populate the final roster with formulas that return the store, month, inspector and date from the currently recommended option. Do not retype the selected plan.

keyed_consistency.decision_key: The workbook must define every pass, fail and not-applicable status used by feasibility and explain the source rule represented by each status.
keyed_consistency.rationale: The populated rationale must name the live recommended option and accurately summarize its cost, compliance and travel trade-offs.
keyed_consistency.answer_alignment: Comparison values, selected option, rationale and final roster must all point to the same result.
keyed_consistency.intended_verdict: The selected option is feasible under every mandatory source rule and is preferred over the other eligible options under the workbook's disclosed ranking.

authoring_plan.tempting_overproduction: Do not place backup, alternate or second inspection assignments into the final executable roster. Contingency guidance may explain how to rerun the model, but each store-month receives exactly one posted inspection assignment.
offline_verification: Open and parse the completed XLSX with an OOXML-aware library.
Inspect formulas, validation definitions, protection, conditional-formatting ranges, calculation settings and print properties.
Recalculate representative assignments and all option aggregates from the two supplied sources.
Test the late-swap input with a whole number above five.
Render the final roster and confirm two US Letter landscape pages.
Compare the recommended option with the formula-linked final roster and written rationale.

original_instruction:
Mikkel, since the recalled ride-on tractor sat on a sales floor for five weeks, I need April and May cross-store safety inspections settled before the Oregon posting deadlines. Use `goldfinch_inspection_inputs.xlsx` for the nine stores, certified supervisors, availability, travel assumptions and operating conventions, and use Gildenhall Alliance’s `oregon_schedule_brief.pdf` for the Oregon rules as of 15 January 2026. Build three complete assignment options, compare their projected cost and scheduling exposure, recommend one, and give the store teams a final roster they can execute. Every store needs one inspection each month, nobody can inspect their own store, and only a certified supervisor can be assigned. Make inputs, calculated results and failed checks unmistakable, and include enough guidance to understand the pass/fail and cost logic. The late-swap assumption normally sits between zero and five, but operations must be able to test a higher whole number without breaking the model. The final roster will be posted as two US Letter landscape pages, one month per page. Save the finished workbook as `cross_store_inspection_model.xlsx` at the top level of the working directory, using exactly that filename.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/goldfinch_inspection_inputs.xlsx` — Goldfinch Agricultural store roster, certified-supervisor roster, home stores, availability, inspection windows, travel data, cost assumptions, scenario conventions and posting-format requirements.
- `references/oregon_schedule_brief.pdf` — Gildenhall Alliance summary of the Oregon predictive-scheduling posting, rest-interval and schedule-change rules applicable to the inspections as of 15 January 2026.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `cross_store_inspection_model.xlsx` — A live two-month cross-store inspection model containing three populated options, calculated compliance and cost results, a justified recommendation, and an executable final roster. (Place the file at the top level of the working directory.; Use formulas rather than pasted constants for calculated checks, costs, option summaries and the recommended roster.; Keep editable decision and assumption cells clearly separate from calculated cells.; Permit a nonnegative whole-number late-swap assumption above the normal zero-to-five planning range.; Configure the final roster to print as exactly two US Letter landscape pages, one month per page.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
